records.description: If you're on Product Hunt, you probably don't feel behind on AI. This is a highly filtered group. At B43 we train dozens of people a week, and you'd be surprised how many of them do feel behind. This course was built around their exact questions. Unscary AI puts it on your iPhone as 42 short lessons on how ChatGPT and the rest actually work, and how to use them well. It needs iOS 26, and the whole course is free. Enjoy.

records.name: CookBank
records.tagline: A small recipe app that turns cups and spoons into grams
records.description: CookBank turns cups and spoons into grams, scales any serving, and keeps each step by its ingredients. Use it on the web, iPhone, or Android.

records.name: Tucker
records.tagline: Hyper-local AI gardening coach for home food growers
records.description: Most gardening apps give advice for everyone. Tucker coaches your specific garden. Hyper-local means it knows your suburb, live weather, and what food you want to grow. Upload a photo of your space, get one clear action every morning. Hit a problem? Photo-diagnose it and Tucker follows up until it's fixed. The longer you use Tucker, the more specific it gets. Memory is the product. $4.99/month. Works anywhere in the world.

records.name: Which is the best VPN for UAE
records.tagline: vpn,app,
records.description: Dubai VPN is a simple, lightweight VPN app designed primarily for Android users who need quick online privacy without complex configurations. Key Features: Connect immediately without any registration or account creation.App Split Tunneling: Easily choose which specific apps route through the VPN and which bypass it. Free & Premium Nodes: Access free monitored servers or upgrade to ad-free high-speed PRO servers. Download https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.azacodes.dubaivpn

records.name: vibe-learn
records.tagline: Learn while you vibe code — a tutor skill for Claude Code
records.description: vibe-learn is a free, open-source Claude Code skill that teaches you while it builds. After meaningful code or a real bug fix, Claude adds a short Learn block (2–4 takeaways, jargon explained from scratch), a bug-class breakdown, or a mental model, plus optional non-blocking quizzes. Progress carries across sessions with spaced review, streaks, challenges, teach-back, and Anki flashcard export. Your code doesn't change — you just understand it.

records.name: Fantasy Tabletop Helper
records.tagline: Create art and keep your campaign alive
records.description: Fantasy Tabletop Helper brings fantasy art, campaign organization and tabletop reference tools together for game masters and players. Create and remix character portraits, scenes, items and maps; organize creations in your library; and chronicle adventures with session logs and recap tools. Browse a D&D 5e compendium. Campaign visibility controls let game masters choose what to reveal to the party while keeping hidden information private.

records.name: Bynamely
records.tagline: One update per story about the people you follow.
records.description: Follow the actors, filmmakers and athletes you care about. When twenty outlets report the same story, Bynamely shows it once, with every source linked. Each update says how sure we are: confirmed, reported or unverified. Summaries are written by AI and checked against the reporting; a summary that says anything the sources don't is thrown away. Free plan: follow 5 people and get a daily email digest. Paid plans add instant alerts.

records.name: AI Career Next
records.tagline: AI-powered career guidance for your next move
records.description: What’s next for your career? AI Career Next helps you find the answer. Built for ambitious professionals seeking clarity about what comes next. - Personalized AI career advice - Discover your market value - Explore your strengths and career options - Turn insights into action with Career Coach - And more tools for your career Whether you're considering a career move or aiming for your next level, AI Career Next helps you gain clarity, discover possibilities, and move forward with confidence.

records.name: PaidTaskers
records.tagline: A directory of verified paid tasks platforms
records.description: A directory of verified paid-task platforms across surveys, AI training, app testing, transcription, and chat — rates, payouts, and requirements checked monthly.

records.name: Chatwik
records.tagline: All-in-one platform for customer communication.
records.description: Connect all your support channels - WhatsApp, Live Chat, Messenger, TikTok, Instagram, Email, Telegram, LINE, and CRM in one AI-powered platform. Chatwik is an all-in-one customer communication platform that brings your conversations into one unified workspace. With a shared team inbox, CRM, Help Center, analytics, and customizable chat widget, Chatwik helps teams collaborate efficiently, respond faster, and build stronger customer relationships.

records.name: I Don't Like This Website
records.tagline: Remember the websites you never want to visit again
records.description: I Don't Like This Website is a simple Chrome extension for remembering websites you don't want to visit again. Mark any website you dislike, optionally add a note explaining why, and the extension will remind you the next time you return. It's useful for avoiding sketchy stores, frustrating services, low-quality sites, misleading content, or anything else you don't want to accidentally revisit. Your list and notes are stored locally in your browser. No account required.

records.name: AeroCinematic AI
records.tagline: AI director turns drone clips into cinematic property tours
records.description: AeroCinematic AI is an autonomous cinematic director for real estate. Drone operators upload raw FPV clips, and the platform's computer vision detects property highlights — pools, solar arrays, open kitchens — then auto-sequences a luxury showcase video. Each tour ships with localized AI voiceover narration, beat-synced licensed music, and animated data overlays (beds, baths, square footage, nearby amenities). No manual editing, no timeline. Upload and list.

records.name: First Jobby
records.tagline: The best job finder platform to start your career
records.description: First Jobby helps you land your first job. It's completely focused on entry-level roles and jobs for candidates with less than 3 years of experience. No senior listings, just real opportunities for grads and early-career professionals.

records.name: ETHICAL AI AUDIT TOOLKIT FOR STARTUPS
records.tagline: Practical toolkit for ethical AI auditing and compliance
records.description: A complete professional toolkit designed to help startups identify, assess, document, and manage AI-related legal, ethical, privacy, cybersecurity, and governance risks. Turn security concerns into actionable frameworks, templates, and scorecards.

records.name: moshr
records.tagline: A chaotic text-based anonymous forum
records.description: This is an attempt to modernize an ancient format. The biggest problem textboards have is that typing and reading text is boring. I tried to make typing and reading a bit more fun with cool text animations and effects. I also have a unique moderation system where the creators of threads are allowed to moderate discussion by being able to mute and kick trolls, spammers, bad faith commenters, and thread derailers. I hope that these tools allow for communities to set their own rules and norms.

records.name: GhostGuard
records.tagline: Stop phishing, scams and malicious sites before you click
records.description: GhostGuard helps users and teams detect phishing, malicious links, scam websites, and risky online interactions before they cause harm. It provides contextual browser protection and real-time risk analysis, helping people recognize suspicious activity and make safer decisions online.

records.name: Fomo Trendings
records.tagline: fomo
records.description: Top 15 trending crypto tokens on Solana, Base, BNB and Robinhood, ranked live by market-cap gain since we spotted them, with instant Telegram alerts.

records.name: Vandal
records.tagline: A strategic card game. Build decks and craft powerful cards.
records.description: Craft your deck and send it into battle. Salvage the wreckage, then use your Workshop to forge entirely new cards - choosing their abilities and art style before adding them to your deck. Need inspiration? Rivet, your AI deck-building assistant, finds combos, synergies, and unexpected ways to make your deck hit harder. Battle. Salvage. Forge. Repeat.

records.name: RoomMaroc
records.tagline: Find student housing near your campus in Morocco
records.description: RoomMaroc makes student housing in Morocco easier to find. Students can search for rooms, apartments and roommates by city, university and budget, compare listings and contact landlords directly. We’re solving a fragmented housing experience where students often rely on Facebook groups, WhatsApp and intermediaries. Starting with student housing, RoomMaroc aims to build a trusted housing marketplace for Morocco. Built in Morocco 🇲🇦

records.name: FichierEmail
records.tagline: Fresh B2B email lists of French companies, built to order
records.description: FichierEmail builds contact files on French companies the day you order them, from the official registries (SIRENE, RNE, BODACC). 10M+ establishments, filtered by profession, NAF code and department. Each record: verified professional email, landline and mobile, director's name, revenue, net income, an A-G financial health score, the website's tech stack and social profiles. Struck-off and insolvent companies are removed. Optional refresh into HubSpot, Brevo, Zapier or Make. From €19.

records.name: Bundle
records.tagline: Take on more clients without hiring, AI preps, you sign off
records.description: FiscFort (Fiscal Fortress) Bundle gives accounting firms a fully managed, AI-powered platform for all their clients. Each client gets a private, isolated, EU-hosted environment with its own web and mobile portal. Clients upload invoices and receipts, AI reads multilingual documents, matches bank statements, and prepares VAT and payroll reports. You review, sign off and file. Onboard a client in under 20 minutes. Plans from €299/mo for up to 10 clients.

records.name: Budget Guru
records.tagline: Cash-flow forecast for irregular, multi-currency income
records.description: Most budget apps tell you what you spent. Budget Guru tells you if you'll have enough on a given date: payment waves, “can I afford this?”, hourly and multi-currency income, yearly costs set aside monthly. The AI explains — the code does the math.

records.name: Sage from Saywise
records.tagline: Your 24/7 AI recruiter
records.description: Sage is your 24/7 AI recruiter. Sage works like a human recruiter and does everything for you even while you're sleeping. Sage hand-picks the best opportunities for you the moment they come out, prepares your resume and creates a free portfolio site, auto-applies for you (if you want), and runs mock interviews and gives you feedback. The best part: you just text her anytime. No app required, no complicated sign-up process.

records.name: WPClientHub
records.tagline: WordPress agency OS: free for 3 sites, 0% billing fee
records.description: WPClientHub runs every client WordPress site from one hub, on any host. Safe updates with a restore point, screenshot diff and one-click rollback. Incremental backups to S3-compatible storage you own (Backblaze B2, R2, Wasabi). Uptime checks every 60 seconds, SSL monitoring and vulnerability scans. White-label PDF reports, Stripe client billing with a 0% fee, and a client help desk on Agency+. Free for 3 sites; $19/mo for 10, unlimited sites $99/mo.

records.name: aida — Native Markdown Editor for macOS
records.tagline: Markdown for humans
records.description: aida writer is a Markdown editor that doesn't ask you to choose between writing naturally in plain text and seeing your document formatted. Type bold and it's bold. Type a heading and it looks like a heading. Whether you are creating quick notes, or writing larger documents - you can remain focused on your content, not how to markup the document so that it formats correctly. Under the hood, your document is always a standardmd file — nothing proprietary, nothing that only opens in this one app.

records.name: Hotel Lobby AI
records.tagline: Turn two photos into orange-booth duet videos.
records.description: Hotel Lobby AI turns two photos into a stylized 13-second duet video set in a warm orange recording booth. Upload one clear subject per photo—friends, couples, pets, or original characters—then choose 480p, 720p, or 1080p output. The built-in template handles the booth scene, 4:3 framing, centered studio microphone, and performance direction, so you can create a polished short-form video without prompts or editing. Preview, download, and share it anywhere.

records.name: Framecast
records.tagline: Record a site, drop it in a device, export. Or ask AI.
records.description: Framecast is a Mac app that records a smooth scroll of any website, places it in one of 27 device mockups, adds a background and exports MP4, MOV, GIF or a still. Connect Claude, Cursor or Codex and your AI agent can do every step, with your approval.

records.name: Agensi
records.tagline: AGENSI...FIND A GOOD DIGITAL TOOLS
records.description: Give your AI agent superpowers. Install a SKILL.md skill in 30 seconds. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, and 20+ agents.

records.name: Worthle
records.tagline: Discover the politicians the news ignores
records.description: Most citizens only know a handful of celebrity politicians, yet hundreds shape national laws. Worthle is a daily civic deduction game where you deduce one lawmaker's disclosed net worth in 6 tries using real-time hotter/colder feedback. Explore 1,500+ lawmakers across the US, UK & Canada (with more countries to come), uncover official ethics filings, play showdown minigames, and build your civic binder.

records.name: Quota
records.tagline: Your Claude usage limits, always in the corner of your Mac
records.description: Quota is a tiny native Mac widget that keeps your Claude limits on screen: the 5-hour session, the weekly limit and the per-model limit, as rings in any corner. Hover for reset times and a forecast of when your current pace hits the wall. One click keeps your Mac awake for long Claude Code runs. Optional OpenRouter and DataForSEO balances. Sign in with the Claude plan you already have. No Terminal, no telemetry. $15 once, free updates.

records.name: TermiGram
records.tagline: SSH terminal and SFTP inside Telegram
records.description: Manage your servers without leaving Telegram. TermiGram brings SSH, SFTP and multiple workspaces to your phone, with saved profiles, reusable and bulk snippets, two Share Link models, SSH keys, AI help and optional Cloud Terminal sessions. Included proxy routing hides your source IP from destination servers. Encrypted credentials and an optional Master Password protect saved access. Start with a five-day trial, then keep using Free or choose a paid plan.

records.name: RogIQ
records.tagline: AI Marketing OS for small teams who refuse to think small
records.description: RogIQ is the AI Marketing OS for small teams who refuse to think small. One or two people can't keep up with strategy, content, SEO, and reporting alone — and hiring five more isn't the answer. You don't need to get bigger. You need to get smarter. Brand IQ, Strategy OS, Create Suite, and Rogue Intelligence — powered by 150+ LLMs. Nothing publishes without your yes. Start free.

records.name: CollabSafe
records.tagline: Helping influencers, brands freelancers succeed
records.description: CollabSafe is an all-in-one workspace for creators, brands, agencies, and freelancers to manage their collaboration business. From cold email outreach and follow-ups to contracts, e-signatures, international invoices, payment reminders, creator insights, and media kits, CollabSafe brings essential tools together in one affordable platform helping you save time, reduce tool costs, manage partnerships efficiently, and get paid faster.

records.name: Drawgle
records.tagline: Most AI apps look the same. Yours won’t.
records.description: Design premium and consistent mobile app UI from prompts, screenshots, or visual references. Keep screens consistent with shared tokens and export Tailwind HTML plus an Agent Pack.

records.name: InboxPilot
records.tagline: AI email assistant for team inboxes in Gmail and Outlook
records.description: AI email automation for Gmail and Outlook. InboxPilot drafts replies to customer email from your price list, orders and documents. You review and send.

records.name: FansStack
records.tagline: Create, connect, monetize, and grow with FansStack
records.description: FansStack brings creators, artists, and fans into one unified platform for subscriptions, premium content, digital products, services, direct messaging, and community engagement. Unlike platforms focused on a single monetization model, FansStack gives creators multiple ways to earn from one profile while keeping 80% of eligible earnings. One account connects content, commerce, audience growth, and fan relationships in one place.

records.name: BoringKit
records.tagline: Tools for boring everyday tasks
records.description: BoringKit brings everyday tools for PDFs, images, text, data, and developer tasks into one place. Start with 58 useful tools, use the API to automate them, and skip hunting for a different website every time. Still in beta, with many more tools coming.

records.name: People Commons
records.tagline: Common ground for HR and AI
records.description: Practical AI tools, ready-made resources and curated reading for people who run HR.

records.name: clkr.work
records.tagline: 200+ free tools for everyday digital tasks
records.description: 200+ free browser-based tools for everyday digital tasks — from PDFs and images to developer utilities, calculators and converters. No signup or installation. Many tools process files directly in your browser. Use Tool Finder to describe what you need, discover related tools and toolkits, and move from one task to the next without hunting across dozens of websites. A practical digital toolbox, not another collection of AI wrappers.

records.name: Cadence
records.tagline: Pregnancy prep, birth plans and a one-tap contraction timer
records.description: Prepare for birth with lessons, breathing practice, packing lists, appointments and your own notes. Time contractions with a tap and keep a shareable summary. Built for iPhone. Cadence Pro is required after onboarding.

records.name: Gen AI X App
records.tagline: From App Idea to Mobile App in Minutes.
records.description: AI app builder for Flutter. Turn text prompts into native iOS & Android mobile apps with live cloud compilation, physical device QR testing, and GitHub sync.

records.name: Detego
records.tagline: See what Claude Code made but never showed you
records.description: Claude Code creates files (e.g. screenshots, HTML pages, PDFs) in temp folders you never open, so you end up asking it to describe what you could have looked at which can cost you time and tokens. Detego collects them in your Mac's notch. Hover to open the shelf to preview a file or drag it out. It never takes focus from your terminal, so you keep focus where it matters. Items are grouped by session and prompt. Needs macOS 14+ and Claude Code. 14-day free trial.

records.name: DOER
records.tagline: The next generation of professional networking
records.description: DOER is the next generation of professional networking. Profile, connections and groups, then courses, services, memberships and a business listing in the same place. No ads, no algorithm, zero commission on what you earn, on every plan including free. Built solo in Sydney. Launching with the Founding 25: four weeks from 12 October, sell what you know, keep every dollar, and the first 25 to three sales keep our top plan free for life while they stay active.

records.name: Cute Fonts Generator
records.tagline: Get 100+ cute fonts & heart symbols to copy and paste
records.description: Create cute, kawaii and aesthetic text with 100+ copy-and-paste fonts, heart symbols and decorative combinations. Preview likely compatibility for Instagram, TikTok, Discord, X and Facebook, get safer alternatives when a style may not work, and copy in one tap. Everything runs locally in your browser—free, private and no signup required.

records.name: AI Automation ROI Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate the real ROI of automating any business process
records.description: Most automation ROI calculators just do hours × hourly rate — and that number is almost always wrong, because it ignores exceptions and maintenance cost. We built a free calculator that factors in volume, exception rate, and build+upkeep cost — so you get a realistic break-even number instead of an inflated one. No email required. Takes 2 minutes.

records.name: Freelance Scope & Pricing Calculator
records.tagline: Know what to charge: hourly rate + fixed project price
records.description: Most pricing tools stop at an hourly rate. This one turns your income goal, billable hours, overhead and project complexity into a minimum hourly rate and a fixed project price, then shows where the money goes: your pay, a complexity premium and overhead. One click copies a proposal summary with a 50/50 payment schedule. Assumptions are visible on screen. Runs in your browser, no account, nothing saved or uploaded.

records.name: XF1 Mouse 
records.tagline: Trackpad gestures for any mouse on your Mac
records.description: XF1 Mouse brings trackpad-style gestures to any regular mouse on your Mac. Hold the right button, draw a quick stroke and let go. Flick left or right to switch desktops, up for Mission Control, and use simple combos to change tabs, close or reopen them, minimize windows and more. There are 25+ built-in actions, and you can record your own gestures and map them to any shortcut. A normal right-click still works like always. No account, nothing leaves your Mac, and it's free during early access.

records.name: Cluttersignal by Clutterstrike
records.tagline: A second opinion on every email and link you get
records.description: ClutterSignal is a browser extension that tells you if a link or email looks suspicious or dangerous, and why before you act. Choose between a local check or the cloud check to our servers. Any information sent to our servers are only used to diagnose the message and nothing is stored after running through our security screen. Start with the 7-day free trial, then $4.99/month. Chrome now; Firefox and Edge coming.

records.name: Videly
records.tagline: Turn your product into a professional video in minutes
records.description: Videly turns your product into a polished launch, demo or feature-announcement video in minutes. Paste your website URL or describe your product: Videly captures real screenshots of your app, writes the script, art-directs custom motion design for your brand, adds AI voiceover and music, and renders an MP4 you can tweak and export. No cookie-cutter templates, no motion designer, no editing timeline. Free to start with 3,100 credits, no card required.

records.name: Pixerbook Platfrom
records.tagline: All in one workflow platform for modern photography studios
records.description: Leads, quotes, bookings, payments, galleries and album review — for photography studios.

records.name: prepsavvy
records.tagline: The savviest way to ace your exams
records.description: We are thrilled to announce prepsavvy, the first fully AI-powered adaptive exam preparation platform to help students and professionals ace their exams. Our proprietary adaptive engine learns from your performance on the GMAT, GRE, ACT, and other exams and provides questions and study guides tailor made to help you focus on your weakest areas. Study smarter, not harder. prepsavvy

records.name: Bookora
records.tagline: Read and listen to your own EPUB and FB2 books on Android
records.description: Bring your EPUB and FB2 books to Android. Read comfortably or listen with text-to-speech and follow highlighted text. A Bookora account is required. Available on Google Play with optional in-app purchases.

records.name: Noxtill
records.tagline: AI business platform for sales, CRM, automation & growth
records.description: Noxtill is an AI-powered all-in-one business operating platform for small and growing businesses. Manage POS, CRM, bookings, orders, inventory, payments, reputation, SEO, marketing, workflows, customer support, commerce and business intelligence from one connected system. AI tools including an AI Assistant and AI Phone Receptionist help automate repetitive work, surface opportunities and keep teams focused on growth.

records.name: On Air: Your Apple Music Playlist Host
records.tagline: Voice Intros for your music
records.description: Ever wanted facts & info about songs/artists songs on your Apple Music playlists? Then this app could be for you! On Air gives you a short, fact-based or reflective intros before songs in your playlists. Know some facts about a song? Submit your own facts to share with others Earn badges as you use the app and share acheivements with others Website: https://onairintro.app/ $3.99 monthly or $3.33 monthly equivalent if purchase annual (which also has a 3 day free trial)

records.name: GuideCast WIFI
records.tagline: A tour guide system with no receivers or mobile data
records.description: GuideCast turns smartphones into a wireless tour guide system—no dedicated receivers or mobile data required. A guide speaks into one phone, while participants listen in real time on their own phones over Wi-Fi. • iOS & Android • Tested with 37 simultaneous listeners • Tested up to 50m A 5GHz Wi-Fi router and high-capacity power bank are recommended. An all-in-one battery-powered router can also be used. Built for tours, museums, exhibitions, factory visits, schools, and group events.

records.name: rylivo
records.tagline: AI phone assistant for incoming business calls
records.description: rylivo answers incoming business calls, handles approved FAQs, captures callback requests and sends call summaries by email. Businesses keep their number through call forwarding. Appointment booking requires a supported connected calendar. Provided by Rylivo UG (haftungsbeschränkt), Berlin. Monthly plans: EUR 99 / 299 / from 499. Annual billing: EUR 84 / 254 / from 424 per month equivalent, billed upfront. Prices exclude VAT. Official terms and usage allowances are on the pricing page.

records.name: CloudStackly
records.tagline: Cloud publishing and campaign reports for SEO agencies
records.description: CloudStackly gives SEO agencies one workspace for client profiles, campaign briefs, source articles, and supporting cloud publications. Plan AWS Link campaigns, select connected Cloud Link platforms, review content, follow publication and live-URL checks, track credits, and export client-ready reports. New workspaces can start with 15 free publishing credits. CloudStackly reports delivery status; it does not promise search indexing or ranking gains.

records.name: Age Calculator
records.tagline: age calculator
records.description: Free online age calculator. Calculate your exact age in years, months, days and hours from your date of birth. Find out how old you are instantly — no sign-up.

records.name: Co-Found
records.tagline: Find your co-founder and build in one shared workspace
records.description: Co-Found connects developers, designers, and creators looking to build startups together. Instead of cold LinkedIn messages, founders connect through thoughtful project pitches. Once there's chemistry, teams move into a private workspace with chat, kanban roadmaps, and an AI Startup Prenup to align on equity and roles. It's a shared team environment with useful tools to build a successful business, launch projects, and get early feedback from the community.

records.name: Siena - Finding Connections For You
records.tagline: Clients, investors, partners, and more, found for you
records.description: Tell Siena a little about what you're looking for and she'll pass it to the Waivly team. Whether you're interested in joining Waivly, looking for a connection, or exploring something specific, she'll make sure your request gets to the right place.

records.name: Tailor AI - You Job Hunt Partner
records.tagline: Search every job. Tailor application. All on your machine
records.description: Tailor AI finds jobs across 15 job boards plus Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby career sites, scores them against your CV with AI, and tailors every application — all on your machine. Bring your own API key.

records.name: Glimbench
records.tagline: Private, no-sign-up tools for images and spreadsheets
records.description: Remove backgrounds into full-resolution transparent PNGs, combine table screenshots into editable Excel files, and batch-convert HEIC photos to JPG. Glimbench processes files locally in your browser, with no account required. Review OCR results before exporting XLSX, CSV or TSV, and download JPG batches as ZIP files. Free tools for everyday image and spreadsheet tasks.

records.name: 8-Bit Startup
records.tagline: Build your business in-game and in real-life.
records.description: 8-Bit Startup is a gamified todo-list app designed for entrepreneurs that mixes productivity and fun. Building a business can be relentless, 8-Bit Startup is our attempt at sprinkling a bit of fun into your work.

records.name: Bannerproof
records.tagline: Catch trackers firing before cookie consent — in 2 minutes
records.description: Bannerproof scans your site like a real visitor and shows exactly which trackers fire before cookie consent — including Google Consent Mode v2 issues your CMP won't tell you about. Unlike consent-management tools that just manage the banner UI, Bannerproof checks what actually loads in the browser, catching misconfigurations that slip through after every deploy. Free scan in under 2 minutes, no signup required.

records.name: Fumi
records.tagline: Just write. AI turns your thoughts into useful notes.
records.description: Fumi is an AI-powered notes app that turns whatever you capture into useful structure. Type, speak, add a photo or file, or paste a link. Fumi organizes it into notes, checklists, tasks, reminders, calendar items, and saved places. Ask questions across your notes, see deadlines in Calendar, and browse places on a map. Your notes stay on-device; everyday use needs no account. Available in English and Japanese on iPhone.

records.name: Underdog
records.tagline: The most loyal AI, 100% local and private
records.description: Underdog is a personal AI that runs 100% on your computer. It handles email, calendar, meeting notes, dictation and errands without sending your content to a cloud AI service. Its fast model, Woof 4B, runs at about 115 tokens a second on a MacBook Air, and the 27B model scores 33.7 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Invite-only beta on Mac, with Windows in beta.

records.name: ReelOxa
records.tagline: Automate Your Instagram. Grow Your Business.
records.description: ReelOxa brings Instagram automation into one simple platform for creators, brands, coaches, agencies and businesses. ReelOxa stands out with AI that understands the user's comment, language, and context instead of sending generic replies. Its built-in AI learns about the business and responds accordingly, making conversations feel more natural and relevant. It works 24/7, helping businesses continuously engage with customers and audiences, respond to comments and messages with links.

records.name: Scientist Leaving USA
records.tagline: A real-time tracker of America's scientific brain drain
records.description: Scientists Leaving USA tracks named researchers who've left U.S. universities and labs for roles abroad — mostly China, but also Canada, France, and elsewhere. Each entry documents their field, education, and career history, plus why they left: funding cuts, visa uncertainty, or targeted recruitment programs. Sourced from news coverage, university announcements, and primary interviews, the database is a running record of the ongoing talent outflow reshaping global science.

records.name: Reloopa
records.tagline: Multi-vendor marketplace: Laravel API + native Android app
records.description: Reloopa is a ready-to-deploy multi-vendor marketplace: Laravel 11 REST API, Filament admin panel, and a native Android app (Kotlin) for buyers and sellers. Real-time chat, flash sales, Stripe/PayPal/COD checkout, and RajaOngkir shipping.

records.description: Copy on one device. Paste on another. Remote Clipboard syncs text and files in real time through a short-lived room link. Use it from a browser or the rclip CLI on laptops, phones, servers and virtual machines. Share with people or let AI agents drop off results, pick up files and pass work between agents. Keep multiple named clipboards, restrict private rooms to invited emails, and choose when everything expires. Public rooms need no sign-in.

records.name: Peekabop
records.tagline: Karaoke lyrics around your MacBook's notch, word by word
records.description: Peekabop shows the lyrics of whatever's playing right under your MacBook's camera, lighting up word by word in time. Spotify, Apple Music, or YouTube and other sites in Safari, Chrome, Arc or Firefox. Pick the notch, a floating pill, subtitles or full screen, and one of 16 effects. On macOS 26 it even shifts the lyrics to match a music video's edit. No account, no analytics. €9.99 once, 7 days free.

records.name: Ground-Truth SEO Scanner
records.tagline: Scan and track your SEO/GEO without the snake oil
records.description: The Ground-Truth SEO Scanner checks any public website against what Google, Bing, web standards bodies and AI crawler operators have documented. Scans are free. Every finding is explained and cited, and the same snapshot, ruleset and settings always yield the same report.

records.name: PolyDrive Endless
records.tagline: A calm, endless drive through low-poly worlds
records.description: PolyDrive Endless is a calm driving game that runs in your browser. Cruise procedurally generated coastal highways, mountain passes and neon cities with day/night cycles, weather and a generative radio. No timer, no finish line, no download.

records.name: My Thoughts
records.tagline: A space to be heard, understood, and connected.
records.description: My Thoughts is a social journaling app where you share ideas, follow thinkers you love, and reflect freely. Write publicly or keep it private. No algorithm — just honest thoughts from real people.

records.name: Flip Timer
records.tagline: Focus. Flip. Repeat.
records.description: Flip Timer is the minimalist Pomodoro & focus timer with a beautiful animated flip clock display. Customizable sessions, fullscreen focus mode, and daily tracking — built for deep work.

records.name: Colabrix
records.tagline: Colabrix is project management for growing teams
records.description: Colabrix is project management for growing teams. Start with one board of issues, then turn on stories, sprints and milestones when you're ready.

records.name: lazychat

records.name: Smart Investment Ideas for Beginners
records.tagline: Smart Investment Ideas for Beginners

records.name: Sudoku for Dad

records.description: I built Sudoku for Dad after watching my dad play Sudoku on apps full of ads, pop-ups and clutter. I thought I could make him something nicer, clean, simple and focused on the puzzle. After a lot of feedback (Dad is a surprisingly demanding product tester), it’s reached the point where he actually prefers it. No ads, no subscriptions, no nonsense. Just Sudoku.

records.name: HabitRush
records.tagline: One life. Start today, not Monday
records.description: HabitRush is a calm habit tracker with gentle reminders, travel mode and insights that show which habits lift each other. Pay once, use it for life. No subscription, no AI, no ads.

records.name: Samethru
records.tagline: Finds the bugs between your database, API and screen
records.description: Samethru checks that what your app shows on screen matches your API and your database, and shows exactly where it goes wrong when it doesn't. It plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI. Your assistant traces where each value comes from; Samethru compares it across all three and names the bug: wrong prices, dates shifted by timezones, lists cut off by pagination, stale caches and 8 more. Runs on your machine, read-only. Free.

records.name: Catalog Change Review

records.name: Carrusel Dump

Preview 4:5, 1:1, or 16:9 crops, edit the order, and generate captions. No account; your photos stay on your iPhone. Free for 2 carousels/month, with an optional one-time PRO upgrade and no subscriptions.

records.name: WENOTIFT

Requests, signed agreements, invoices and delivery proof stay connected in one partnership record.

records.name: Chinese Character Stroke Order

Built by a Chinese learner who wanted more practical tools for everyday study.

records.name: jailbrain.ai

records.name: Clippio

Every stack (Go, Angular, iOS, Python, React) has a builder, a debugger and a read-only reviewer. Decisions and progress are saved in the project.

records.description: FollowSheet reads your Gmail and fills a Google Sheet with who you last emailed and who wrote last. It flags Needs reply, Overdue, Due today and Gone cold. No server, your data stays in your Google account. Free plan; Pro $7/mo for a daily email digest.

records.name: Jev Model
records.tagline: Fast decisions with probabilities for software teams.
records.description: Jev Model is a System One decision model for developers. It accepts shared state as text, JSON objects, or arrays of text and answers up to eight Choice, Score, or Noul questions in parallel, returning structured outputs with probabilities for classification, routing, scoring, guardrails, and human-review workflows.

records.name: usatopsellit.com
records.tagline: Top Site To Best Accounts
records.description: "USATopSellIt – Your trusted destination for top-selling products in the USA, where quality meets unbeatable value!"

records.name: Smoke App
records.tagline: All-in-One E-Commerce Platform for Smoke Shops
records.description: Online ordering, delivery, and loyalty programs for smoke shops

records.name: Nepika
records.tagline: Scan you skin. Skip the guesswork
records.description: Most skincare apps guess. Nepika scans. Real hydration, barrier, and redness data — not a filtered selfie or generic advice. Track your skin over weeks and finally see the pattern, not just the feeling. Ask real people dealing with the same skin issues — no ads, no paid influencers. No diagnoses, no overclaiming. Just the truth about your skin, so you stop buying the wrong products.

records.name: Murmur
records.tagline: Turn voice notes into tidy, structured Markdown instantly
records.description: Speak or upload audio and Murmur instantly transcribes, removes filler words, and organizes content into summaries, key takeaways, and action items. Export to Notion, Obsidian, or Word in one click. 50+ languages supported with private cloud storage.

records.name: Ruthie Israeli
records.tagline: Couples therapy Los Angeles
records.description: Work with an experienced relationship therapist in NYC and Los Angeles offering couples and sex therapy to support intimacy, communication, and relationships.

records.name: NXTVortex Engage
records.tagline: Get more Google reviews on WhatsApp, automatically.
records.description: Customers mean to leave a Google review - then forget. Set when Engage sends the WhatsApp ask after a visit or job. Everyone gets the same message; if something wasn’t right, they can reply so you can make it right early. Join the waitlist.

records.name: GSC Regex Library& Filter Builder
records.tagline: Build Your Brand or URL Folder Regex
records.description: 25+ copy-paste RE2 regular expressions for Google Search Console: filter AI Overview conversational queries, non-branded traffic, law firm case intent, ecommerce SKUs, and indexing bloat.

records.name: Clozure
records.tagline: 19 AI departments that run your business 24/7
records.description: Clozure gives you 19 autonomous AI departments — Sales, Marketing, Lead Gen, Finance, CS, and 14 more — that work 24/7 to grow your business. Each department finds leads, sends emails, makes calls, and closes deals. Starting at $99/month.

records.name: Playsaic
records.tagline: Track your games and find what to play next
records.description: Bring your physical and digital games together in one Shelf. Import your Steam library and wishlist, track playthroughs and sessions, write reviews, and see which games you can play now. Playsaic helps you choose your next game with recommendations and price comparisons. All features are free.

records.name: Vasudev AI Arena
records.tagline: A gamified arena where builders build, compete & level up
records.description: Vasudev AI Arena is a gamified builder community where you turn curiosity into real-world projects. Complete quests, build and ship, contribute to open-source bounties, earn XP, unlock badges, climb seasonal leaderboards, and earn rewards. Arena makes building feel like a game—with real skills, projects, and reputation behind every level.

records.name: Snailbox
records.tagline: Snap a paper bill, get reminded before it's due
records.description: Take a photo of a letter. Snailbox gives you a short summary of what it's about and tells you how much you need to pay, if anything. If there's a deadline, it reminds you before it's due. No account, no bank connection.

records.name: Figure8
records.tagline: Create product mockups with 3D devices.
records.description: Drop in screenshots or videos, animate devices rotating or spinning, add customizable interactive elements like widgets and Siri, and change backgrounds to create polished app mockups.

records.name: AngryMailer
records.tagline: A lightweight email marketing app for Windows
records.description: AngryMailer is a lightweight email marketing app for Windows. Create professional emails with a visual editor, manage recipients through multiple methods, and send campaigns from a simple native desktop application. Unlike many browser-based email marketing tools, AngryMailer is designed for users who prefer a fast, straightforward Windows workflow without relying entirely on cloud platforms.

records.name: Lemtik Security
records.tagline: Bridging the latency between alert and action
records.description: Africa's first civilian-grade command and control platform. Real-time intelligence and coordinated dispatch for security teams in Lagos. Unlike WhatsApp groups and paper logs, Lemtik unifies incident reporting, patrols, CCTV and access control in one dashboard, plugs into your existing hardware (no rip-and-replace), keeps audit-ready records, and uses AI to flag patterns while operators stay in control.

records.name: AccessLens
records.tagline: Free website accessibility scans in plain English
records.description: AccessLens scans any website against WCAG 2.1 standards and turns the results into a plain-English, prioritized to-do list — not a wall of jargon. Free scan, no account required.

records.name: Cellula
records.tagline: Draw, run and share cellular automata in your browser
records.description: Cellula lets you draw cells on an unlimited map, press Play and watch Conway’s Game of Life evolve. Change the rules of life, save your worlds into projects and share them with a link. Free, in your browser.

records.name: Fyka Notes
records.tagline: Notes for Windows that stay on your own computer
records.description: Free notes app for Windows with headings, checklists, tables and folders. Your notes are saved on your own computer, with no account and no cloud.

records.name: Rupex
records.tagline: Before you buy, Ask Rupex
records.description: RUPEX makes expense tracking easier without requiring access to your SMS or notifications. With Share to RUPEX, simply share a supported payment receipt or screenshot from Google Pay, PhonePe, or Paytm. RUPEX detects the transaction details on-device, lets you confirm the category, and saves it in seconds. It combines this with budgets, EMIs, savings goals, spending insights, and Ask RUPEX — all in one simple personal finance app.

records.name: Lumrise
records.tagline: Your personalized 30-day glow-up plan
records.description: Lumrise creates a personalized 30-day self-care and appearance plan based on your goals, preferences, and photos. Choose Face, Skin, or Body and get tailored daily guidance, routines, and progress tracking. I built Lumrise to make personal appearance goals simpler and more actionable. I'm launching on Product Hunt to get feedback, improve the product, and help people build better daily routines.

records.name: Lokal
records.tagline: Websites, ordering & AI receptionist for local businesses
records.description: Lokal is an all-in-one platform for local businesses: professional websites, commission-free online ordering, an AI receptionist that answers every call 24/7, loyalty programs, and built-in SEO. $1 for the first month, then $99.99/month. No contracts, cancel anytime.

records.name: Floodtide
records.tagline: Update all of you mac apps from one place
records.description: Update supported Mac apps together, including App Store apps, and manage Homebrew packages in one place. Choose optional automatic updates. Free scanning and a 14-day full trial, then £10.99 once for 3 Macs. macOS 13+.

records.name: Citrine
records.tagline: On-device Android trading for Coinbase futures in the U.S.
records.description: Citrine runs Coinbase Advanced U.S. perpetual-futures automation locally on Android. Funds stay at Coinbase; API keys stay encrypted on your device. Test with Paper Mode, account-aware Shadow Mode, and historical backtesting using one-second bid/ask data and reconstructed paths, including fees and available funding. Monitor BTC and ETH, inspect strategy details, and manage exchange-hosted stop-loss and take-profit protection. Free Explore tier; live automation via Google Play subscription.

records.name: Mise OS
records.tagline: Event operations for curated agencies
records.description: The n8n inspired operating system for curated event agencies: visual event maps, vendor & budget control, run-of-show, and a live client portal.

records.name: Tidy — Your Mac, sorted in seconds
records.tagline: Your Mac deserves clean directories
records.description: Tidy sorts the clutter on your Mac's Desktop into tidy folders. Rules for the obvious files, Jev AI for the rest. Preview everything, undo anything. Free.

records.name: TAI
records.tagline: Trust & Attention Intelligence
records.description: TAI is a read-only Chrome extension that checks LinkedIn jobs, recruiters and messages, and shows what's real before you apply, accept or reply. It catches ghost jobs, flags AI-written posts and scores your profile. How to use: 1) sign in with LinkedIn at taicheck.com, 2) add TAI to Chrome, 3) get your scores. The first full check is free.

records.name: imov.dev
records.tagline: All-in-one AI platform for videos, images, and music
records.description: imus.dev is a unified creative AI platform for generating videos, images, and music from text prompts. Includes text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and AI music generation with pay-as-you-go credits.

records.name: Clipappboard
records.tagline: Find and organize what you copy on your Mac
records.description: A local clipboard history for Mac with search, previews and collections. Start free; unlock more organization, text editing as a new copy, image annotation and window mode with a one-time Pro purchase. English and Spanish. macOS 12+, Intel and Apple Silicon.

records.name: The Pipe Review
records.tagline: Your CRM prints one number. Your pipeline implies a range.
records.description: Type in your open deals, put your own odds on each, and it plays the quarter out 10,000 times: the range you will actually land in, your odds of hitting target, and the few deals causing most of the doubt. Free, no account.

records.name: Live Transcript
records.tagline: Captions for everything your Mac plays
records.description: Live Transcript for Mac, by Polytopic Systems, turns whatever your Mac plays, and your microphone if you like, into live captions at the notch. Transcribed on your Mac, saved to a searchable history, exported when you want.

records.description: 58 svelte components for apps and AI interfaces

records.name: Whistle Image Converter
records.tagline: Fast, free, private bulk image converter
records.description: Convert images to AVIF, WebP, PNG or JPG free. Batch convert WebP to PNG or JPG, resize and tune quality privately in your browser. No uploads, no sign-up.

records.name: SupportOps by Nexus Core

records.description: Support gives support teams an autonomous AI workforce across WhatsApp, Phone, Email, SMS, and Web Chat. Unify multi-channel tickets, monitor system latency, and deploy custom agentic workflows—all from one real-time dashboard.

records.name: SWD Develop CSS Minifier
records.tagline: Minify CSS instantly, right in your browser
records.description: Minify CSS directly in your browser to reduce file size without uploading your code to a server. Paste your CSS or load a file, minify it instantly, compare the original and optimized size, then copy or download the result. Free to use, privacy-friendly, and built for a fast development workflow.

records.name: CardKit
records.tagline: Scan cards and documents. Keep them private on your device.
records.description: CardKit keeps cards and document copies in a private vault on your device. Scan an ID, passport, membership or loyalty card, add extra pages if needed, and find it later by name, tag or recognized text. Unlike cloud-based wallets, CardKit requires no account or upload. Images and details are encrypted locally, with PIN or biometric unlock. You can also show supported QR codes and barcodes, export selected details as a PDF, and create an encrypted backup.

records.name: Quiet Pomodoro
records.tagline: A focus app for people who hate focus apps
records.description: Most focus apps are cluttered enough to be a distraction themselves. Quiet Pomodoro is a clean, minimal timer for iPhone: pick a task, start a session, and it blocks your distracting apps until the break. Daily streaks show your progress. That's all.

records.name: BFF - Get Supported By Your #1 Fans

records.description: Discover exclusive creator content, behind-the-scenes moments, drops, and experiences beyond the feed.

records.description: A curated, opinionated index of the tools that make AI systems work in production — ordered by stack layer, not by popularity.

records.name: xmlcpc

records.description: XMLCPC is a self-serve XML/CPC marketplace for advertisers. Register, fund what you need, and bid from $0.25 USD per click in a real-time first-price auction on redirected commerce clicks. Run keyword / category / country line items today; optionally attach an XML/RTB endpoint that bids in the same auction. Losers are never billed. Stripe top-up and signed-in reporting for spend, wins, and funded top-ups. Part of MoltAd’s XML/CPC hub.

records.name: OppStream

records.name: Free Games for Seniors

records.name: Is This AI?

records.description: A game where you look at real photos and videos and vote whether they’re AI-generated or not. Train your eye, compete with others, and discover how hard it’s become to tell what’s real.

records.description: A complete Notion operating system for web design agencies to find, qualify, audit, contact, follow up with, and convert leads.

records.description: Quick quizzes about everything, from everywhere. A lightning-fast, mobile-first, JavaScript-free, evolving trivia game.

records.description: Aesthetic clinic software built for UK medical aesthetics. Manage bookings, patient records, digital consent, prescribing, payments and aftercare from £25/month. 14-day free trial, no contract.
